subject: Next steps: 30-min demo availability + scope check
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Keller <jkeller@novaflow.io>
Cc: PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 14:02:00 -0400
Subject: Next steps: 30-min demo availability + scope check

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the call this morning — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Recap from discovery
- Primary use case: in-product smart replies + knowledge base summarization for support tickets (~40k tickets/mo).
- Expected inference pattern: short prompts (10–80 tokens) with occasional longer summarization jobs (600–1,200 tokens) for batch jobs overnight.
- Throughput target: ~200 concurrent small requests during peak support hours; batch job latency can be higher.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 required; data residency in US; SSO (SAML) for RBAC.
- Decision timeline: procurement + security review in ~4–6 weeks.

Next steps we recommend
1) 30‑minute demo (product + infra architecture) — include PrIyom (solutions) to cover throughput and deployment options.
2) Share a short prompt sample and one schema example so we can prepare a focused demo showing cost/latency tradeoffs.
3) Draft mutual action plan attached for your review (see attachments).

Proposed 30‑minute demo windows (all ET) — please pick whichever works or suggest alternatives:
- Thu Aug 21, 10:00–10:30 AM ET
- Fri Aug 22, 2:00–2:30 PM ET
- Mon Aug 25, 11:30 AM–12:00 PM ET

If none of these work I can open a short poll. Also cc'd Irene to help with calendar coordination.

Attachments: redwood-30min-demo-agenda.pdf (one‑pager), mutual-action-plan-draft.xlsx 

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
http://redwood.com

From: Jordan Keller <jkeller@novaflow.io>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@novaflow.io>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 16:14:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: 30-min demo availability + scope check

Thanks Mateo — this capture is helpful. Lena (CTO) is joining the thread. A couple of clarifications before we lock a slot:

- The nightly summarization runs are typically split across a few workers; each job can be 800–1,000 tokens.
- We have an internal SLA that requires 95th percentile latency < 400ms for the short prompts.
- Security is a blocker for us: we need encryption-in-transit + at-rest and a minimum audit log retention of 1 year.

Of the slots you suggested, Fri Aug 22 2:00 PM ET works best. If that gets your team in a pinch, Thu Aug 21 at 10:00 AM is our fallback.

Also, can you confirm whether Redwood supports VPC private deployments or only hosted/dedicated today? We'll want that on the agenda.

Jordan Keller
Head of Product | Novaflow
jkeller@novaflow.io | (312) 555-0198

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Keller <jkeller@novaflow.io>
Cc: PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@novaflow.io>
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2025 09:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: 30-min demo availability + scope check

Perfect — Fri Aug 22, 2:00–2:30 PM ET is locked on our side. I’ve sent a calendar invite with a brief agenda and a Zoom link (invite attached to calendar).

Quick answers: 
- Redwood offers Hosted, Dedicated (reserved pools), and Private deployments (VPC / on‑prem options). We'll have PrIyom cover architecture and tradeoffs in the demo.
- We support TLS for all traffic and AES‑256 at rest; SOC2 compliance is standard for our enterprise plans — we can connect you to our security team for evidence (SOC2 report) during the procurement window.

Action items before the demo
- Jordan/Lena: share 3–5 representative prompts and a sample record (anonymized) so PrIyom can prepare an architecture that hits your SLA targets. 
- Mateo: will send a one‑page agenda + mutual action plan (attached).
- PrIyom: please prepare a short section on autoscaling, KV cache impact on latency, and VPC deployment checklist.

Attachments: redwood-30min-demo-agenda.pdf, mutual-action-plan-draft.xlsx

Thanks — see you Friday.

—Mateo

Thanks — I'll cover architecture and ops during the demo. A couple of prep asks so we can hit the SLA targets in the session: 

1) Please drop 3–5 representative short prompts and 1 example long summarization input (anonymized). A plain .txt or exported CSV is fine (attached sample format).
2) Can you confirm peak QPS for short prompts and expected batch window (local time)?
3) Who is the security contact we should loop in for SOC2 evidence and onboarding checklist?

I attached a quick sample prompt-set file to show the format we'd like (sample-prompt-set.txt). If you prefer, we can run a quick live test in the demo — bring the sample data and we'll run against a staging model to show latency numbers.

Cheers,
PrIyom Das
